title: SoL-Refiner: Speed-of-Light One-Step Refinement for High-Resolution Video
title_zh: SoL-Refiner: 一步到位的高速度视频精炼

paragraphs.en: High-resolution video generation is expensive, as its cost grows rapidly with the number of spatiotemporal tokens. A practical alternative first generates a lower-resolution video and then applies a refiner, but conventional multi-step refinement introduces a second sampling bottleneck. We present SoL-Refiner , a one-step video refiner that transforms low-resolution model outputs into 4K videos with a single denoising step. Our three-stage recipe combines high-resolution continual training, reinforcement learning (RL) post-training, and a final one-step distillation. We introduce Refiner-Bench, a video refinement benchmark constructed from the outputs of different video generators, and use a shared-input protocol to compare refiners at approximately 2K output resolution. At 2K, the one-step SoL-Refiner outperforms all external refiners on the VBench and UniPercept averages, while at × 2176 3840\!\times\!2176 it improves both metrics over the three-step LTX-2.3 Refiner. With the complete acceleration stack, SoL-Refiner achieves an 8.91 × 8.91\times speedup in refinement latency over the same baseline in our 2K latency setting.
paragraphs.zh: 高分辨率视频生成成本高昂，因为其开销随着时空token数量的增加而迅速增长。 一种实用的替代方案是先生成较低分辨率的视频，再应用精修器，但传统的多步精修会引入第二个采样瓶颈。 我们提出了SoL-Refiner，这是一种单步视频精修器，能够通过单次去噪步骤将低分辨率模型输出转换为4K视频。 我们的三阶段方案结合了高分辨率持续训练、强化学习（RL）后训练以及最终的单步蒸馏。 我们提出了Refiner-Bench，这是一个由不同视频生成器的输出构建的视频精修基准，并采用共享输入协议在约2K输出分辨率下比较各精修器。 在2K分辨率下，单步的SoL-Refiner在VBench和UniPercept平均分上超越了所有外部精修器，而在2176×3840分辨率下，它在这两项指标上均优于三步的LTX-2.3精修器。 借助完整的加速方案，SoL-Refiner在我们的2K延迟设定中，精修延迟相较同一基线实现了8.91倍的加速。

paragraphs.en: Video generation has advanced toward higher visual fidelity and output resolution, but at substantial inference cost [ 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] . Larger models increase the cost of each denoising step [ 5 , 6 ] , while higher resolutions lengthen the spatiotemporal token sequence and raise the cost of every step. Smaller models and lower-resolution sampling reduce this burden [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] , but can compromise fine texture and local detail [ 4 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成在视觉保真度和输出分辨率方面已取得进展，但推理代价高昂 [ 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] 。 更大的模型增加了每个去噪步骤的成本 [ 5 , 6 ] ，而更高的分辨率会拉长时空 token 序列，并提高每一步的成本。 更小的模型和更低分辨率的采样可以减轻这一负担 [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] ，但可能损害精细纹理和局部细节 [ 4 ] 。

paragraphs.en: A two-stage design addresses this trade-off by separating low-resolution content generation from high-resolution detail refinement [ 10 , 11 , 12 ] . The base model establishes motion, composition, and scene content at low resolution, while the refiner enhances textures and local details at the target resolution. The base stage can also use more aggressive acceleration, and the refiner repairs the resulting artifacts. Existing refiners, however, often require multiple target-resolution denoising steps, creating a second sampling bottleneck [ 13 , 10 ] . Many refiners are also developed for a particular base generator, and their transfer to outputs from other generators is rarely evaluated.
paragraphs.zh: 两阶段设计通过将低分辨率内容生成与高分辨率细节精修分离来解决这一权衡问题 [ 10 , 11 , 12 ] 。 基础模型在低分辨率下建立运动、构图和场景内容，而精修器在目标分辨率下增强纹理和局部细节。 基础阶段还可以采用更激进的加速方法，而精修器则修复由此产生的伪影。 然而，现有的精修器通常需要多次目标分辨率去噪步骤，从而形成第二个采样瓶颈 [ 13 , 10 ] 。 许多精修器还是针对特定基础生成器开发的，它们向其他生成器输出的迁移也很少得到评估。

paragraphs.en: We introduce SoL-Refiner, a one-step video refiner that transforms low-resolution inputs into high-resolution videos with improved local detail ( Figures 1(a) and 1(c) ). It can refine outputs from different base generators without modifying or retraining the base models. Starting from a pretrained LTX-2.3 checkpoint, training follows three stages: high-resolution continual training on paired videos, reinforcement learning (RL) post-training with frame-based reward models, and one-step distillation. We further reduce encoding, decoding, and denoising latency with a tiny autoencoder (TAE) [ 14 ] and Sol-Engine [ 15 ] . Within the refinement stage alone, the complete acceleration stack achieves an 8.91 × 8.91\times speedup over the three-step LTX-2.3 Refiner in our 2K latency setting. Paired with a four-step MiniMax H3 base model, the full two-stage pipeline is 27 × 27\times faster than direct full-resolution H3 generation ( Figure 1(b) ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 SoL-Refiner，这是一种单步视频精修器，可将低分辨率输入转化为具有更优局部细节的高分辨率视频（图 1(a) 和图 1(c)）。 它可以精修来自不同基础生成器的输出，而无需修改或重新训练基础模型。 从预训练的 LTX-2.3 检查点出发，训练分为三个阶段：在成对视频上进行高分辨率持续训练、使用基于帧的奖励模型进行强化学习（RL）后训练，以及单步蒸馏。 我们进一步通过微型自编码器（TAE）[14] 和 Sol-Engine [15] 降低了编码、解码和去噪的延迟。 仅在精修阶段内，完整的加速方案在我们的 2K 延迟设置下，相比三步的 LTX-2.3 Refiner 实现了 8.91 × 8.91\times 的加速。 与四步 MiniMax H3 基础模型配对后，完整的两阶段流程比直接的全分辨率 H3 生成快 27 × 27\times（图 1(b)）。

paragraphs.en: We introduce SoL-Refiner, a video refiner that upsamples and refines low-resolution outputs from multiple base generators in a single denoising step.
paragraphs.zh: 我们介绍 SoL-Refiner，这是一种视频精炼器，能够在单个去噪步骤中对来自多个基础生成器的低分辨率输出进行上采样和精炼。

paragraphs.en: We develop a three-stage training recipe that establishes high-resolution refinement through continual training, improves perceptual quality through RL post-training with frame-based rewards, and distills the resulting multi-step refiner into a one-step model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了一套三阶段训练方案：通过持续训练建立高分辨率精修能力，通过基于帧奖励的强化学习后训练提升感知质量，并将所得的多步精炼模型蒸馏为单步模型。

paragraphs.en: We introduce Refiner-Bench, a video refinement benchmark constructed from the outputs of different video generators, and use a shared-input protocol to compare refiners. At 2K resolution, SoL-Refiner outperforms the evaluated external refiners on average VBench and UniPercept scores, and improves over the three-step LTX-2.3 Refiner from 720p to 4K.

paragraphs.en: SoL-Refiner targets synthesis artifacts in AI-generated videos, including distorted local structures and inconsistent textures. Resolution enlargement is optional: refinement can improve a generated video at its existing resolution or accompany upsampling ( Figures 1(a) and 1(c) ). Prior work also addresses generated video quality. VEnhancer combines spatial and temporal super-resolution with video enhancement [ 16 ] . Ultra Flash trains on degradations tailored to generated videos and combines reward-enhanced one-step distillation with cascaded streaming preference optimization [ 17 ] . Its design centers on high-resolution streaming generation. Our focus is the refinement of generator outputs, including artifact correction without spatial enlargement, and we assess transfer across base generators.
paragraphs.zh: SoL-Refiner 针对AI生成视频中的合成伪影，包括扭曲的局部结构和不一致的纹理。 分辨率放大是可选的：细化可以在现有分辨率下改进生成的视频，也可以伴随上采样进行（图1(a)和图1(c)）。 已有工作也涉及生成视频的质量问题。 VEnhancer 将空间与时间超分辨率同视频增强相结合 [ 16 ] 。 Ultra Flash 在针对生成视频定制的退化数据上训练，并将奖励增强的一步蒸馏与级联流式偏好优化相结合 [ 17 ] 。 其设计以高分辨率流式生成为核心。 我们的关注点是生成器输出的细化，包括无需空间放大的伪影校正，并且我们评估了在不同基础生成器之间的迁移能力。

paragraphs.en: Cascaded generators use a low-resolution stage for content and motion, followed by high-resolution processing. Imagen Video interleaves spatial and temporal super-resolution models [ 2 ] ; FlashVideo learns a few-step flow-matching detail model [ 4 ] ; and LUVE combines latent upsampling with high-resolution experts [ 18 ] . The released LTX-2.3 and LingBot-Video pipelines use three-step and eight-step refiners, respectively [ 10 , 13 , 19 ] . SoL-Refiner can serve as the refinement stage in such a cascade, using one denoising step to improve the base video. We evaluate released refiners on shared inputs from multiple generators to separate their refinement performance from the choice of upstream generator.
paragraphs.zh: 级联式生成器使用低分辨率阶段来处理内容与运动，随后再进行高分辨率处理。 Imagen Video 交替使用空间和时序超分辨率模型 [2]；FlashVideo 学习一个少步数流匹配的细节模型 [4]；而 LUVE 将潜在上采样与高分辨率专家相结合 [18]。 已发布的 LTX-2.3 和 LingBot-Video 流水线分别使用三步和八步的细化器 [10, 13, 19]。 SoL-Refiner 可以作为此类级联中的细化阶段，使用一步去噪来提升基础视频的质量。 我们在来自多个生成器的共同输入上评估已发布的细化器，以便将细化性能与上游生成器的选择区分开来。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion-based restoration provides relevant priors and training methods for refinement. Upscale-A-Video uses recurrent latent propagation for temporally consistent upscaling [ 20 ] , and SeedVR supports variable video lengths and resolutions through shifted-window attention [ 21 ] . One-step methods reduce repeated denoising: DOVE uses staged latent-pixel training [ 22 ] , UltraVSR uses a degradation-aware schedule and distillation [ 23 ] , and SeedVR2 uses adversarial post-training [ 24 ] . FlashVSR combines one-step distillation with causal sparse attention and a lightweight decoder [ 25 ] . We include SeedVR2 as a one-step restoration baseline in our evaluation. Our task concerns defects introduced during video synthesis; recovering spatial resolution is one application of the refiner, rather than its defining objective.
paragraphs.zh: 基于扩散的修复为精细化提供了相关的先验和训练方法。 Upscale-A-Video 使用循环隐空间传播实现时间上的一致超分 [ 20 ] ，SeedVR 通过移位窗口注意力支持可变的视频长度和分辨率 [ 21 ] 。 单步方法减少重复去噪：DOVE 使用分阶段的隐空间-像素训练 [ 22 ] ，UltraVSR 使用感知退化的调度与蒸馏 [ 23 ] ，SeedVR2 使用对抗后训练 [ 24 ] 。 FlashVSR 将单步蒸馏与因果稀疏注意力及轻量级解码器相结合 [ 25 ] 。 我们在评估中将 SeedVR2 作为单步修复基线。 我们的任务关注视频合成过程中引入的缺陷；恢复空间分辨率只是精细化器的一种应用，而非其定义性目标。

paragraphs.en: Our training builds on distribution matching and reward-based post-training. DMD2 combines teacher distribution matching with adversarial supervision [ 26 ] , SF-V uses adversarial training for single-forward video generation [ 27 ] , and ImageReward introduces Reward Feedback Learning [ 28 ] . In Ultra Flash, perceptual rewards directly supervise the student during one-step distillation [ 17 ] . We instead apply frame-based rewards to the multi-step refiner before distilling it through a few-step intermediate student. Distillation combines the teacher’s distribution supervision with implicit distribution alignment [ 29 ] and a projected DiT discriminator, drawing on projected adversarial supervision in PiD [ 30 ] .

paragraphs.en: We accelerate refinement with Sol-Engine [ 15 ] , which combines kernel fusion with sparse attention based on Sol-Attn [ 36 ] to reduce denoising computation. paragraphs.en: SoL-Refiner makes high-resolution video generation more efficient by moving most denoising computation to a lower-resolution base generator and reserving one target-resolution step for refinement. Continual training learns the low-to-high-quality mapping, reward feedback learning improves perceptual quality, and staged DMD-GAN distillation with a projected DiT discriminator compresses refinement to one step. On Refiner-Bench, the one-step model outperforms external refiners in average VBench and UniPercept scores. In our 2K latency setting, the one-step refiner with TAE and Sol-Engine reduces refinement latency from 57.461 to 6.447 seconds, an 8.91 × 8.91\times speedup over the three-step LTX-2.3 Refiner.
paragraphs.zh: SoL-Refiner 通过将大部分去噪计算转移到较低分辨率的基础生成器，并保留一步目标分辨率的精细化处理，使高分辨率视频生成更加高效。 持续训练学习从低质量到高质量的映射，奖励反馈学习提升感知质量，而采用投影 DiT 判别器的分阶段 DMD-GAN 蒸馏将精细化压缩为一步。 在 Refiner-Bench 上，单步模型在 VBench 和 UniPercept 的平均得分上优于外部精细化器。 在我们的 2K 延迟设置中，结合 TAE 和 Sol-Engine 的单步精细化器将精细化延迟从 57.461 秒降低到 6.447 秒，相比三步的 LTX-2.3 Refiner 实现了 8.91 × 8.91\times 的加速。

paragraphs.en: On Refiner-Bench, the 23-step model achieves higher VBench and UniPercept averages than the one-step model. Our refinement objective targets local visual detail while preserving the base video’s content and motion. Correcting large semantic, geometric, or motion errors is not an explicit training objective. Stage II evaluates three sampled frames per video using image-quality and preference reward models. These frame-based rewards do not directly measure long-range temporal consistency. Refiner-Bench covers AI-generated videos from several base generators; camera-captured degradations and broader video editing tasks remain outside this study.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Refiner-Bench 上，23 步模型比一步模型获得更高的 VBench 和 UniPercept 平均分。 我们的精炼目标在保持基础视频内容与运动的同时，针对局部视觉细节。 纠正较大的语义、几何或运动错误并非明确的训练目标。 第二阶段使用图像质量与偏好奖励模型对每个视频采样的三帧进行评估。 这些基于帧的奖励并不能直接衡量长程时间一致性。 Refiner-Bench 涵盖来自多个基础生成器的 AI 生成视频；相机拍摄的退化与更广泛的视频编辑任务不在本研究范围之内。

sents.en: Our refinement objective targets local visual detail while preserving the base video’s content and motion.
sents.zh: 我们的精炼目标在保持基础视频内容与运动的同时，针对局部视觉细节。
